g.text: Split identities, analyses and 11 tissue results
Keep original metadata IDs and procedure names
Separate genes, diseases and association pairs
Three CSV exports are imported into these tables
SQL IMPORT / groups are defined in R
Shared parameters are already in the main data
MGI + Ensembl ID; provisional symbol match
3 VIEWS / saved queries over existing tables
Arrows show data preparation, not foreign keys. Dashed import boxes are staging tables; dashed view box is a query layer.
tissues and bespoke_species contain reference lists defined in SQL. Source: database/integrated/impc_group6_workflow.sql.
